class.name: BakedRTAO
class.brief_description: Pre-baked 3D texture ambient occlusion and bent-normal volume that can run standalone or with RTAO.
class.description: Ray-traces static scene geometry ([MeshInstance] and [MultiMeshInstance]) and optional [LocalRTAO] volumes into a 3D [Texture3D] resource storing bent normals (RGB) and scalar ambient occlusion (A). Can run completely standalone without [RTAO] using a lightweight 2D canvas overlay for ultra-high performance on low-end hardware and mobile, or automatically integrates into [RTAO] when present.

method.name: bake
method.description: Ray-traces static scene geometry within [member extents] and stores the resulting bent normals and ambient occlusion in [member baked_texture] and [member baked_data].
